== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tauntaun (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Tauntaun]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100693 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100693], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100693-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>ec3e7b70abd12c2e58c51590af71dc0c27dfbb3176a3b6f306118eb6b9c1acfb</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
